summary.note: Two independent readings per report, field order reversed between them. Only agreement reaches the ledger. Where the two passes split, that is recorded here and nothing is published.

agreed.note: The filed stage of operation says In cruise. The write-up says in descent

The filed stage of operation says On the ground, in inspection or maintenance. The write-up says The condition (fwd entry door warning light false illumination) occurred in flight at 1000 ft AGL after takeoff, per the narrative

The filed nature of condition says No test. The write-up says Emergency light power packs were checked and found less than minimum 15 minutes, troubleshooting was performed, and a replacement power pack passed an operational check per AMM 33-51-06-200-801 — tests/checks were clearly performed.

The filed stage of operation says On the ground, in inspection or maintenance. The write-up says The condition occurred during gear retraction, which happens in flight — not during ground inspection or maintenance
The filed part condition says DETACHED. The write-up says the selector handle/lever was found stuck, was cleaned, and then operated correctly (arm/disarm) — it was not detached
The filed part says STRINGER. The write-up says skin damage (the narrative states the underlying SKIN was found damaged and repaired, not the stringer)

The filed system says Fuselage Main, Longeron/Stringer. The write-up says Corrosion found at stringer S-36L in the LH and RH stabilizer torsion box compartments (internal), i.e., the stabilizer, not the fuselage main structure
The filed part condition says CORRODED. The write-up says The narrative describes the seat track crown as WORN, with wear exceeding allowable limits per SRM, and makes no mention of corrosion

The filed stage of operation says On the ground, in inspection or maintenance. The write-up says The odor occurred in flight - during climb, shortly after takeoff, and lasted several minutes before clearing
The filed system says DC Power Distribution System. The write-up says COMPLETE LOSS OF AC POWER IN FLIGHT
The filed nature of condition says A warning went off. The write-up says NO EICAS MESSAGE DISPLAYED
The filed nature of condition says A warning went off. The write-up says The main cabin door exterior handle was difficult to open and close, with noticeable binding while opening the door handle
The filed nature of condition says No test. The write-up says PERFORMED EMERGENCY LIGHTS TEST IAW AMM 33-51-00-5
The filed stage of operation says Descending. The write-up says During climb out
The filed part condition says CRACKED. The write-up says A dent to the slat outer skin, repaired per REO 670-57-42-2551-REV-A — no crack is described anywhere in the narrative

The filed nature of condition says No test. The write-up says A battery pack capacity check per AMM 33-51-06-200-801 was performed twice, a retest was done, and troubleshooting per WDM 33-51-34-1 and 33-51-61-4 was performed, which found three battery packs would not hold a charge
The filed part condition says WORN. The write-up says A CRACK WAS FOUND ON RH WING FIXED LEADING EDGE SKIN

The filed part condition says FAULTY. The write-up says No faults found — multiple BITE checks showed no faults, the fault could not be duplicated, and the RH flow control card was replaced only as a precautionary measure with 'no defects noted' on the ops check.
The filed part condition says GOUGED. The write-up says CRACK INDICATION (confirmed crack in the link fitting, damage removed by reaming)

The filed stage of operation says On the ground, in inspection or maintenance. The write-up says Odor occurred in flight - strongest during takeoff and twice during cruise flight; ground maintenance was only the subsequent corrective action
The filed part condition says NO DISCREPANCY. The write-up says The fitting was damaged/worn and 'REQUIRES REPLACEMENT' per EA 365943, and was replaced — i.e., a definite discrepancy existed
The filed stage of operation says Climbing. The write-up says Taxiing

The filed what the crew did says Aborted take-off. The write-up says The event occurred while taxiing, just prior to applying take-off thrust (just above idle). The crew applied higher thrust for taxi and then brought the throttles back to idle, which cleared the CAS messages. No take-off roll was begun, so no take-off was aborted.
The filed nature of condition says No test. The write-up says OPS CHECKS GOOD AT THIS TIME (a functional/operational check was performed)

The filed nature of condition says No test. The write-up says Performed an operational test of cabin emergency lights and signs IAW MM 33-51-00-710-009-A, which found the L2 and R2 exit signs did not illuminate

The filed part says FITTING (with part condition CRACKED, i.e., the fitting is the cracked part). The write-up says The cracked item is the FIN 80VU (antenna fin); it is in contact with the structure lower lateral fitting RH side, which is not described as cracked

The filed nature of condition says No test. The write-up says A test was performed that found cartridge resistance out of limits, and after replacement another test was performed with satisfactory results

The filed stage of operation says Taxiing or ground handling. The write-up says The narrative plainly states the odor occurred during START UP AND TAKEOFF, which contradicts the coded stage of taxiing/ground handling (takeoff is a distinct stage of operation).
The filed stage of operation says On the ground, in inspection or maintenance. The write-up says AIRBORNE WITH ASSOCIATED ODOR IN FLIGHT DECK AND CABIN — the fault occurred in flight

The filed stage of operation says On the ground, in inspection or maintenance. The write-up says The condition started on short final, during flight (fumes/burning rubber smell reported by flight attendants upon reaching the gate)

The filed stage of operation says On the ground, in inspection or maintenance. The write-up says Upon landing and taxiing in — the door failed during normal arrival/ground operation, before any inspection or maintenance began

The filed nature of condition says No test. The write-up says The condition was found through testing: an ops check revealed the emergency pathway lights did not operate, and a continuity check of the power supply fuses found a bad fuse
The filed stage of operation says Taxiing or ground handling. The write-up says ENROUTE NOTICED ELECTRICAL BURN SMELL... LANDED AT NEAREST SUITABLE WHICH WAS DTW

The filed stage of operation says Taxiing or ground handling. The write-up says The fumes occurred in the flight deck and forward cabin in flight, worsening over 3-5 minutes until #2 engine and packs were shut down, forcing a gate return
The filed part condition says UNKNOWN. The write-up says Inspected and found satisfactory — no girt material came out, latch assembly did not break, reinspection OK to service
The filed stage of operation says On the ground, in inspection or maintenance. The write-up says During taxi out and takeoff, in flight operation (the surging occurred while applying takeoff power)
The filed part condition says DENTED. The write-up says PUNCTURED

The filed nature of condition says No test. The write-up says The narrative plainly describes a defect found and verified through testing: emergency lights failed the arm-position functional check, failed again after two charge procedures, and passed the post-repair ops check.
The filed part condition says FAULTED. The write-up says Battery pack was near its life limit (not failed) and was removed and replaced as a life-limit item per AMM
The filed part condition says FAILED. The write-up says Old bottle was not blown; both tests passed and the discharge light extinguished before landing, indicating no actual failure of the bottle
